research_question: In adults undergoing liver (hepatic) resection, do fibrin-based haemostatic agents (fibrin sealant, fibrin glue, fibrin patches, fibrin-coated collagen), compared with non-fibrin haemostatic agents or techniques (e.g. oxidised cellulose, collagen sponges, argon beam coagulation, electrocautery, standard surgical haemostasis), change perioperative all-cause mortality?
control_label: Non-fibrin haemostatic agent or technique (oxidised cellulose, collagen sponge, argon beam, electrocautery, standard surgical haemostasis)
outcome_description: Perioperative all-cause mortality: number of randomised participants who died in hospital or within approximately 30-90 days of liver resection (as defined by each trial), out of the number randomised to each arm (ITT denominators; if only the safety/treated population is reported, use that and note it). Arms with zero deaths are recorded as 0 events with the arm size; trials not reporting mortality are excluded. Multi-arm trials: fibrin arm versus one non-fibrin comparator, combining two non-fibrin arms (summing events and participants) if present. Deaths from any cause only - not treatment-related deaths only, and not late (>=1 year) mortality. No other outcome (blood loss, time to haemostasis, transfusion, bile leak, reoperation, infection) is pooled.
positive_direction: A positive effect size (or RR < 1) means fewer perioperative deaths with the fibrin-based haemostatic agent than with the non-fibrin comparator, i.e. the result favours the fibrin-based agent; RR > 1 means more deaths with the fibrin-based agent.
search_queries: fibrin sealant liver resection randomized controlled trial mortality
fibrin glue hepatectomy haemostasis trial comparison collagen oxidized cellulose
fibrin patch hepatic resection randomised trial outcomes complications
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trial in adults undergoing liver (hepatic) resection
Compares a fibrin-based haemostatic agent with any non-fibrin haemostatic agent or haemostatic technique
Reports mortality data (including explicit zero deaths) with arm sizes, or any quantitative outcome data from which perioperative death counts can be derived
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, editorial, opinion, narrative review, theoretical or protocol paper)
No comparison between a fibrin-based treatment arm and a non-fibrin control arm (e.g. fibrin versus no haemostatic agent at all, or fibrin versus another fibrin agent), or non-randomised design
No quantitative outcome data permitting an effect size (no event counts/denominators, means+SDs, t/F values, proportions or odds ratios); mortality not reported at all
Completely unrelated to fibrin-based haemostasis in adult liver resection (e.g. other surgical sites, paediatric populations, animal or in vitro studies)
moderators_to_extract: Type of fibrin product (liquid sealant/glue vs patch vs fibrin-coated collagen)
Type of non-fibrin comparator (oxidised cellulose, collagen sponge, argon beam/electrocautery, standard haemostasis alone)
Extent of resection / indication (major vs minor; malignant vs benign; cirrhosis prevalence)
Risk of bias and publication year / industry funding
effect_size_note: Pool as a random-effects risk ratio of death (fibrin-based arm / non-fibrin comparator arm) using the number randomised as denominators. Expect sparse/zero-event data; handle double-zero trials per standard conventions (e.g. Mantel-Haenszel without continuity correction, with Peto OR as sensitivity analysis).
